travelerQuestions.title: Traveler questions
travelerQuestions.answerHint: We can answer most questions right away
travelerQuestions.qualityDesc: Based on guest reviews, visitors especially highlight the clean and tidy accommodation, the quiet location in central Daruvar, and the hosts' hospitality. Below are answers to the most common questions.

parking.q: Is parking secure and is there a charge?
parking.a: Yes, all our guests have free private parking right next to the property.

breakfast.a: Yes, we have a newly renovated dining area on site where we serve a fresh, hearty breakfast for our guests. Breakfast can be added when booking.

wifi.a: Yes, free Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and common areas.

therms.q: How far are the Daruvar thermal baths?
therms.a: The Daruvar thermal baths are within a few minutes' walk of the property.

attractions.a: Nearby you'll find Janković Castle park, Daruvar thermal baths, the Church of the Holy Trinity and the city centre.

pets.a: Yes, pets are welcome with prior notice when booking. Additional cleaning fees may apply.

checkin.q: How does check-in work if we arrive late?
checkin.a: Our check-in process is very flexible. Before arrival you will receive clear instructions for self check-in and key or code collection, and the hosts are always available for quick communication.

checkinTimes.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
checkinTimes.a: Check-in is from 14:00 to 22:00, and check-out is by 10:00.

wellness.q: Does the property have wellness (sauna, jacuzzi)?
wellness.a: Yes. Access to the wellness area with sauna and jacuzzi is exclusively for guests who book the wellness apartment.

families.a: Yes, some rooms accommodate up to 4 guests and are suitable for families.

booking.q: How can I book a room?
booking.a: You can submit a booking request via our <bookingLink>booking form</bookingLink> or contact us by email and phone.
